purpose: paired test of image-edge shadow supervision for the local (radius 8) sqrt-luma shadow branch; only change versus aces_shadow_mixed_local1200 is --include-image-edges
registered_by: Claude (Cowork) session, 24 Oct 2026; launched by owner from PowerShell
changed_behavior: loss weight keeps true image-edge pixels (artificial crop edges still excluded) instead of dropping a blanket 40px border; sampling and initialization identical to control
motivation: 4 of 21 shadow-eligible natural TRAIN images have shadow only within 40px of the image edge and were never supervised; local1200 was temporally stable (0.00800 EV) but missed natural shadow accuracy
acceptance: candidate: five natural development gates, natural shadow MSE no worse than coverage4800, frozen predictor/restorer, 384 motion frames with zero negative Y and zero lift, every clip worst-transition mean excess EV <= 0.02; paired: natural shadow MSE at least 5% below local1200 control, original-dev24 shadow MSE no worse than control, each dark-clip mean temporal excess no worse than control. Visual, detail, platform, native and release acceptance are separate.
